⚠ IMPORTANT: This tool formats the declaration only. Packing Instruction numbers, quantity limits, State/operator variations and special provisions must be verified in the current edition of the IATA DGR (your purchased e-book) by a trained/certified DG person before signing. Auto-filled data is for convenience and is based on the UN Dangerous Goods List — always cross-check.

💎 PERFUME QUICK GUIDE (Europe / USA) — click to open/close

A  CLASSIFICATION — which option to use?

1. UN1266 PERFUMERY PRODUCTS, Class 3 (standard DG shipment, IMP code RFL):
• PG II (flash point < 23°C): PAX — PI 353, max 5 L/pkg • CAO — PI 364, max 60 L
• PG III (flash point 23–60°C): PAX — PI 355, max 60 L/pkg • CAO — PI 366, max 220 L
• UN specification packaging + Class 3 label + orientation arrows required. Most perfumes (70-90% ethanol) have FP 12–23°C → usually PG II or PG III.

2. LIMITED QUANTITY (cheaper, no UN spec packaging):
• PG II: Y341 — max 1 L per inner, 1 L per package • PG III: Y344 — max 10 L per package.
• DGD still required. Ltd Qty mark ("Y") on package.

3. EXCEPTED QUANTITY (samples — NO DGD needed!):
• PG II: E2 — max 30 mL per inner, 500 mL per package • PG III: E1 — max 30 mL inner, 1 L per package.
• Only the red/white EQ mark on the box; no DGD, no DG fee. Best for samples.

4. ID8000 CONSUMER COMMODITY, Class 9 (retail-packed): PI Y963, max 30 kg G/pkg. Easiest for finished retail perfume; very common for USA.

B  DESTINATION RULES (worldwide)

• USA: 24-hr emergency phone on DGD mandatory (49 CFR / USG variation). ID8000 widely accepted. DG training certificate required for signatory.
• Europe (EU/UK): IATA rules apply for air; road delivery legs follow ADR (Ltd Qty easy). Carrier variations: LH, AF, BA, KL — check each.
• UAE / GCC: GCAA/Emirates SkyCargo (EK) variations — EK accepts UN1266 PAX & CAO; pre-book DG space.
• India: DGCA — UN1266 accepted; some carriers CAO-only for PG II; MSDS copy usually requested.
• China / Japan / Korea: MSDS in English mandatory at acceptance; some airports restrict PG II on PAX.
• Australia / NZ: CASA follows IATA; standard.
• Courier (DHL/FedEx/UPS/Aramex): each has own DG approval program — perfume needs DG account/contract; ID8000 & Ltd Qty easiest.

C  DOCUMENTS CHECKLIST (full DG perfume shipment)

DGD (2 signed copies) • AWB with "Dangerous Goods as per attached DGD" • MSDS • UN spec packages with Class 3 label, UN1266 mark, orientation arrows • 24-hr emergency number (USA).

Figures are standard industry references — always verify PI numbers, limits, State and operator variations in your current IATA DGR e-book before signing.

🧮 PALLET / OVERPACK CALCULATOR — packing list → DGD & labels (JFS rule)

DGD WEIGHT = (pallet gross − tare) ÷ cartons, 3 decimals cut (not rounded)  •  SC WEIGHT = DGD WEIGHT × cartons = exact declared quantity on each label. Paste the PLT / WEIGHT / DIMENSIONS / QTY rows from the customer packing list, or type them.

✈ DNATA — Master AWB Acceptance Statement (US-bound)

The form handed to DNATA — AWB & HAWB come automatically from the DGD tab; select the staff, add the JFS stamp, then PRINT / SAVE PDF.

📦 US COMPLIANCE FORM — CONSOL / HAWB SHIPMENTS

For US-bound console (HAWB) shipments this form must also be submitted — AWB, date & stamp fill automatically from above. Clean re-set version of the old scanned form.

🛩 AIRLINE FORMS — MAWB Acceptance Statement (per airline)

The airline is detected automatically from the AWB prefix — Turkish (235) gets the TK format, all others the standard format with the airline header. Only that airline's extra forms are shown (Emirates 176 → Emirates forms only). HAWB fills automatically when present. Staff & stamp are shared with the DNATA tab.

🛡 CSD + NON-HAZARD CERTIFICATE — Air India (098) & co.

098 AIR INDIA flights need these 2 extra forms — Cargo Security Declaration (Annexure-II) + Certification for Non-Hazardous Cargo. AWB/route/pieces/weight all fill automatically; stamp shared with DNATA.

🞾 ROYAL AIR MAROC (147) — TSA Acceptance + Consignment Security Declaration

147 RAM flights need these 2 forms — TSA Cargo Acceptance Form + CSD. AWB/route/pcs/weight fill automatically; contents come from the "Contents / description" box above.

⚠ CHALLENGE AIRLINES (752) — DG / Hidden DG Declaration & Indemnity

752 (Challenge / GSA Global Cargo LLC) flights need this indemnity form — shipper details fill automatically from the DGD tab; type the flight/date; stamp shared with DNATA.

🛩 EMIRATES SKYCARGO (176) — USA Statement + Non-DG + Consignee Letter + IDG RFC

The 4 Emirates (176) forms — AWB/route/pcs/weight/staff/stamp all fill automatically. Print only the form you need.

📦 EK GENERAL CARGO — DXB HANDOVER (4 DOCUMENTS)

EK general cargo handed over at DXB needs exactly these 4 documents — MAWB Acceptance Statement, TSA Cargo Acceptance Form, IDG RFC, Shipper's Undertaking. Everything fills automatically from the job; add the SHIPPER's stamp on the Undertaking if you have it.

🤖 SKYD — AI CARGO AGENT DRAFT-ONLY • NEVER SUBMITS

One command prepares the whole job: checks the data, builds AWB draft, House AWBs, Manifest, stickers, airline documents and DNATA forms — then gives you a report. You review and print / submit yourself.

📜 SKYD RUN LOG

📄 WHATSAPP AWB DRAFT VERSIONS

After sending a job's messages and documents, send SKYD PREPARE <job no> AWB in WhatsApp. Each preparation is saved separately. Missing or conflicting information needs your review; a prepared PDF is always a draft. Original inbox messages and attachments remain with the job. This list does not change your open form, approve an AWB or add a signature.

WhatsApp AWB preparation limits: 6 original files, 3 pages per PDF, 4 sheets / 12,000 characters per Excel workbook, 12,000 shipment-message characters, 10 MiB per file and 20 MiB total files. Inputs above these limits need a smaller document set. A General Cargo job containing DG information needs classification clarification. This command prepares an AWB draft; it does not prepare or approve a DGD.

Choose SKYD drafts beside a WhatsApp inbox job.

📲 WHATSAPP INBOX — DG and General Cargo jobs

Staff send DG <job no> (e.g. DG DGS-C00422 or DG AEXP-C00465), then shipment messages, PDFs, Excel files or photos. Check the Job type before OPEN & LOAD. A type change saves immediately; wait for Saved before opening the job or sending a SKYD command. DGS / ELI / ELM open CREATE DGD; other listed types open CREATE AWB. Documents are attached first. Check each document's role, then read one, selected documents or all documents in the job. For an AWB draft through WhatsApp, send SKYD PREPARE <job no> AWB after all documents arrive; review the result under SKYD drafts. All extracted fields remain drafts for review.
